'''Gar''' was a huge [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who collaborated with the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation of [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]]. In exchange for special favors from the occupiers, he helped to keep his fellow Talz in line. This included resisting any attempts at rebellion that were stirred up by offworld adventurers recruited by escaped Talz.
